notes.title: Homeschooler Features, Price Cut & Steam PC Café Release
notes.notes:
Hi immersive Chemistry learners! Futuclass is back with big news: we have applied a fresh coat of paint to our existing VR modules, slashed module prices to 7.99, launched the Steam PC Café version for schools, and we now have a clear path out of early access for this year!

This release includes the following updates:
[list]
[*] App name is changed to “Futuclass Education” to reflect our ambition for creating educational VR gaming content beyond Chemistry
[*] All module prices dropped to 7.99 USD/EUR (previously 9.99)
[*] “Homeschooling features” (detailed below) have been implemented to Atom Structure, Reaction Balancing and Salts modules, and will soon be implemented across all Futuclass modules, which will also become available as DLCs
[*] Futuclass Education can now be bought via Steam PC Café for commercial or school use. The commercial version will grant access to the entire Futuclass module library, currently at 10 Chemistry and 2 Physics modules. (Compared to Quest or Pico versions, this version does not have the Class feature available)
[/list]
Here are the new features, developed mostly with homeschoolers in mind but which also school users will enjoy: 

Futuclass School Environment (currently only available in PC Café version. Coming soon to the regular version): Start your learning journey in style with our brand-new, state-of-the-art facility for immersive science education.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39518504/09d6e622e22f6dc9d010ebfb1bd1feccc8de550d.png[/img]

In-World Tutorials: Say hello to friendly pointing arrows, just-in-time instructions, overall better tutorials, and goodbye to video instructions that clutter up the view. With our in-world tutorials, you'll master the game mechanics without thinking about them, and can thus focus on the learning that matters.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39518504/cb85a5f19379b810200da5682d776187d4def221.png[/img]

Short Questions for Increased Engagement: To keep you focused and ensure you're fully grasping the concepts being taught, we've incorporated short questions throughout each module. These questions serve as checkpoints to gauge your understanding, provide immediate feedback and reinforce the learning material.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39518504/24c467a87af0c698733df1c6aa494595acfbd024.png[/img]

Star Rating for Self-Assessment: After completing each module, you'll be presented with a star rating, allowing you to easily assess your performance. This self-assessment tool encourages you to strive for excellence and motivates you to revisit modules to improve your mastery of the subject matter.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39518504/6284a4cc66ddeb47721bf7e481447b1e08d1cd4f.png[/img]

Get ready to embark on an unforgettable educational journey with this latest Futuclass Education update! We're confident that these new features will enhance both your home and classroom learning experience, making it more engaging and enjoyable than ever before. So, put on your VR headset and let's go - learning has never been so much fun!

notes.notes:
